title: GitHub sign-in comes to Enter
summary:
Enter gained GitHub sign-in, API key management and a balance dashboard, with the Pollen plumbing underneath.

A new Enter auth service adds GitHub sign-in and sessions, giving people a signed-in place to manage their API access.

The dashboard adds a view of the customer meter balance and controls to create, list and delete API keys.

The same PR adds customer integration, API proxy routes and generation-event handling, with database migrations, observability and tests for the new flows.

highlights.title: Manage keys in Enter
highlights.text: Sign in with GitHub to create and manage API keys and view your customer meter balance. [Open API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
